export_traces_jsonl: export a list of evolution traces to a JSONL file with optional gzip compression
export_traces_json: export evolution traces to a JSON file with metadata including total trace count and timestamp
export_traces_hdf5: export evolution traces to an HDF5 file with metadata stored as group attributes
load_traces: load traces from a JSONL, JSON, or HDF5 file with automatic format detection from file extension
append_trace_jsonl: append a single trace object to an existing JSONL file in append mode
